title: The musicians' union
summary: He never belonged to a union, which was weak and ineffective then.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Did you belong to the Musicians' Union? No, I never did. There wasn't a strong group? Well, they was, try to organize a union then. And, uh, they wasn't doing anything with it, you know, just skipping about with it. What bands were in the union? Were there any bands in there? Well, they had a few bands. I remember a couple of fellas talking about it. They had some kind of meetings, but they never did, uh, they never did come to anything with it. Until we later then, this musician later, you know, talking about it.
Yeah, because now the union is pretty strong.
